9147198439681.description:
This half white shalwar kameez is made from soft Boski fabric that feels smooth, light, and comfortable for all-day wear. It is breathable with a soft texture and neat fall, giving a clean and premium look while staying easy to wear in warm and mild weather. The simple half white color offers a fresh and smart style, perfect for Eid, Friday prayers, weddings, and other special occasions with a timeless, elegant feel.

Care Instructions for Boski Fabric:
Always dry clean. Do not spray perfume or deodorant directly on the fabric. Do not wring or bleach. Avoid prolonged direct sunlight. Do not apply water on stains or spray water while ironing.
